articles.title: Sun's Surface Has Whirlpools That Could Spark Solar Flares
articles.summary: The world's biggest solar telescope just took the sharpest pictures of the sun ever. It spotted giant whirlpools of hot, charged gas that might cause solar flares. These swirls could help explain why the sun sometimes blasts out bursts of energy.

articles.title: Tiny Laser Could Make Computers Use Half the Energy
articles.summary: Scientists made a super tiny laser that could make computers faster and use less power. It works with light instead of electricity. In the future, thousands could fit on one chip, cutting energy use in half.

articles.title: Star Trek Uniforms: 60 Years of Bold Fashion Choices
articles.summary: Star Trek turns 60 this year! The show is famous for its space adventures, but also for its ever-changing uniforms. From pastel pajamas to tight spandex, Starfleet fashion has gone through many wild looks.
